Suites.Name: PermanentShopTests
Names: PASS Fresh capital, activation and purchases are never qualifying profit or wallet income
PASS Open P&L previews then reconciles exactly once on closed fills
PASS Unlock occurs on each closed fill even before polling and never reverses after losses
PASS Requested migration: blown $5K/$10K/$25K, fresh $5K => $50K at $0 / $10,000
PASS History alone recovers missing entitlement records and repeated migration is idempotent
PASS Wallet rewards new closed-net highs only, never starting capital, open profit or recovered profit
PASS Purchase validation, insufficient funds, invalid sequence, duplicate intent and reconnect replay
PASS Two same-tier accounts switch independently, copy exactly once and aggregate Stats once
PASS Legacy positions/orders retire safely, cannot be selected/traded, funded history preserved
PASS Durable purchase: storage failure pauses, ambiguous commit retries once, reconnect retains account and debit

Suites.Name: WorldTests
Names: PASS Compressed checkpoint resumes the identical future with identical actions
PASS Restored book retains FIFO, partial fills, cancellations, account funds and protection
PASS Ownership is exclusive; takeover fences stale writes and preserves the checkpoint
PASS World service restart restores live accounts, candles and next random draw without a new auction
PASS Storage outage pauses orders and never creates a replacement market
PASS Corrupt or incompatible checkpoints are rejected instead of reseeded

PASS $100K short 100 NQ with default protection

PASS ES wide stops allow entry and dragging; depletion still liquidates -1
PASS NQ wide stops allow entry and dragging; depletion still liquidates 1
PASS NQ wide stops allow entry and dragging; depletion still liquidates -1

Suites.Name: LeaderboardTests
Names: PASS New / open-only accounts excluded; break-even close qualifies
PASS Negative profit, unlock money and legacy practice excluded
PASS Copied lead and followers each count once; duplicate ledger ids ignored
PASS Restart retains losses; old records and checkpoint roundtrip survive reconnect
PASS Eligibility persists when history is trimmed and net profit returns to zero
PASS Top 100, tie cutoff, descending negatives and duplicate users
PASS Atomic projection accepts a loss; stale writers cannot resurrect earnings
PASS Batched latest score, cached reads, retry recovery and stale rank suppression
PASS A delayed write response cannot regress a newer cached read
PASS Only connected players in server standings; names come from server identities
PASS Studio and production namespaces are distinct
PASS Leaderboard failure leaves engine orders functional
PASS Only committed exchange saves publish; failed saves retain the prior projection

Suites.Name: FundedTests
Names: PASS First join creates nothing; Start creates exactly one $5K starter
PASS Only net realized profit unlocks; starting balance and open P&L never count
PASS Activation needs an unlock, never duplicates, and switching changes the trading account
PASS Copy trading: off by default, explicit lead/followers, per-account limits, clear reports
PASS Disabling copy keeps every position; accounts then trade independently
PASS One player's accounts never trade against each other: player fills are off-book
PASS Legacy accounts retire without funded access or accounting loss
PASS Depleted accounts restart with fresh capital; losses stay in history but not in unlock progress
PASS Copy sizing: exact same/proportional quantity, validated by follower engine
PASS Ladder configuration is validated
PASS Checkpoint v6 keeps profiles; v1 checkpoints restore and migrate

Suites.Name: DepletionTests
Names: PASS Exactly $0 equity blows the account and announces it once
PASS Negative equity blows the account
PASS Negative open P&L with positive equity is not blown
PASS Liquidation reports closing status until it closes at the market price, then allows restart
PASS Restart succeeds once, restores capital and keeps losses/history
PASS A blown copy follower is removed; surviving instances keep trading and prevent free restarts
PASS Depletion notice and free-restart state survive checkpoint/rejoin without duplicate events

Suites.Name: ProgressionTests
Names: PASS Every progression boundary, current-stage reset and top-tier completion
PASS Closed losses reduce progress; activation, capital and switching never add profit
PASS Grandfathered stages retain surplus/losses and migrate exactly once
PASS E-mini tick economics, both directions, partial closing and stop estimates
PASS A fresh $5K can trade ES or NQ; wide stops are allowed within buying power
PASS Positive equity keeps funded positions open below maintenance margin, with no free restart
PASS Only depletion fails; intrastep depletion latches and restart retains closed losses/history
PASS Positive equity survives losses larger than the former daily/trailing allowance
PASS Micro checkpoint migration preserves exposure, history, prices, candles and pending protection
PASS Speed 18 executes all 72 scheduler steps/sec and intrastep OCO crossings latch

Suites.Name: StatsTests
Names: PASS Wins, losses and break-even trades

PASS Copied trades count once per participating account
PASS Repeated depletion updates count each blown attempt once
PASS Restarts keep lifetime losses and blown attempts; current attempt starts fresh
PASS Display-history trimming never erases lifetime totals
PASS Migration rebuilds complete history exactly and labels incomplete history
PASS Saved blown attempts migrate once; old loss-limit breaches are not blown
PASS Drift from an older server build is repaired without double counting
PASS Legacy archives are inaccessible and excluded from funded statistics
PASS Checkpoint round trips, reconnects and repeated restores keep stats identical

Suites.Name: SecurityTests
Names: PASS F1: healthy free resets obey the saved cooldown and budget; each rejection changes nothing
PASS F1: reconnect, restore and successive new instance keys cannot restore a reset budget
PASS F1: a rejected reset settles nothing (positions and working orders untouched)
PASS F1: blown-account restarts use the same saved budget and are refused before any change
PASS F1: 600 fresh-key resets keep retained accounts, checkpoint and portfolio bounded
PASS F1: compaction preserves accounting, statistics, wallet highs, entitlements, receipts and replay protection
PASS F1: a full exchange refuses new accounts before any change while existing players keep trading
PASS F1: per-profile ceiling reserves earned activations and rejects further discretionary accounts
PASS Checkpoint: writer and reader agree at both size limits
PASS Checkpoint: real-size boundary - 32,000,000 raw bytes save and restore, one byte more is refused
PASS Checkpoint: the full stored record (lease + checkpoint + headroom) is checked before commit
PASS Checkpoint: legacy saves still restore; an unreadable save fails closed and is never overwritten
PASS Checkpoint: a save at the previous writer's limit still reopens and saves after this update
PASS F1: compaction never leaves partial state (conflicting archive id is left untouched)
PASS F2: completed receipt replays cause zero writes, grants, debits or pauses; others keep trading
PASS F2: pending and ambiguous purchases stay frozen, replay is refused, retry commits exactly once
PASS F2: new purchases have a saved per-profile budget and an exchange-wide spacing
PASS F2: errors inside a purchase never freeze the exchange; replays are answered during a routine save
PASS F3: reply queues stay bounded by count and age for clients that never subscribe
PASS S1: empty-side fallback quotes never cross; long and short round trips cannot profit
